app.offline: Wonni intanɛt so. Nea woakora no bɛkɔ bere a intanɛt bɛba.

install.hint: Fa Azaria to wo fon anim na ɛmmue sɛ app.
install.ios: iPhone so: mia Share, afei Add to Home Screen.

auth.intro: Kyerɛw wo adetɔn ne wo ka da biara, hu wo sika, na hu wɔn a wɔde wo ka.
auth.resetSent: Sɛ email no wɔ hɔ a, link bi reba.
auth.checkEmail: Hwɛ wo email na si wo akawnt no so dua, afei hyɛn mu.

onboarding.title: Hyehyɛ wo adwuma
onboarding.intro: Nea ɛho hia nko ara. Wubetumi asesa akyiri yi.
onboarding.created: Wo adwuma no ayɛ krado. Kyerɛw wo adetɔn a edi kan!

sale.customerRequired: Paw odetɔni na woahu ka a ɔde wo.
sale.savedOffline: Wɔakora adetɔn no wɔ fon yi so. Ɛbɛkɔ bere a intanɛt bɛba.

expense.operatingHint: Dan ka, lɔre ka, airtime, nneɛma ahyɛde…
expense.savedOffline: Wɔakora ɛka no wɔ fon yi so. Ɛbɛkɔ bere a intanɛt bɛba.

dashboard.netCash: Sika a aba ne nea akɔ
dashboard.noEntries: Biribiara nni hɔ ɛ. Kyerɛw wo adetɔn a edi kan.
dashboard.profitNote: Adetɔn a woayi ɛka afi mu no nyɛ wo mfaso. Nneɛma a aka, adetɔn a wontuaa ɛ ne wura no sika sesa ne nyinaa.

kinds.owner_contribution: Wura no de sika baa mu

customers.phoneHint: Ɛnyɛ ɔhyɛ. Wɔde soma WhatsApp nkaebɔ.
customers.duplicate: Wowɔ odetɔni a ɔwɔ saa din yi dedaw.
customers.phoneInvalid: Kyerɛw fon nɔma; nɔma, ntam ne + ( ) . - nko ara.

accounts.ownerIn: Wura no de sika baa mu

reports.net: Sika a aba ne nea akɔ
reports.notCounted: Wɔayi afi wo akorae baako akɔ foforo mu, wɔnkan

sync.title: Sɛnea ɛrekɔ
sync.warning: Nea wɔakora wɔ fon yi so betumi ayera sɛ wopopa browser no mu nneɛma anaa fon no yera a. Soma kɔ ntɛm bere a intanɛt bɛba.

members.title: Nnipa ne fon
members.intro: Fa onipa ne fon a ɔde yɛ adwuma ka ho. Adwumayɛfo kyerɛw adetɔn ne ɛka. Adwumayɛfo ntumi ntwa biribi mu, ntumi mfrɛ wura, na ntumi ntwe adwuma no nsɛm nyinaa. Ɔhwɛfo tumi siesie mfomso.
members.name: Onipa
members.empty: Wo nko ara na wowɔ hɔ. Fa obi ka ho bere a fon foforo bɛyɛ sotɔɔ no adwuma.

privacy.title: Kokoamsɛm ne nsɛm a wɔakora
privacy.body: Nnipa hu adwuma yi bere a woama wɔn kwan nko ara. Twe bi fi Nhyehyɛe mu. Adetɔn anaa ɛka a wɔakora wɔ fon yi so tena fon yi so kosi sɛ ɛbɛkɔ.

sale.title: Kyerɛw adetɔn
sale.body: Kyerɛw nea odetɔni no tɔe ne sika a woanya. Sɛ ɔda so de wo ka a, paw ne din na wɔahu ka no.

expense.title: Kyerɛw ɛka
expense.body: Da biara ka te sɛ dan ka ne lɔre ka yɛ ɛka. Nneɛma a wotɔe sɛ wobɛtɔn no yɛ nneɛma a woatɔ, wɔkora no soronko.

debt.title: Odetɔni no de ka
debt.body: Akatua a ɛba akyiri no tew ka a ɔde no so. Ɛnyɛ adetɔn foforo.

move.title: Yi sika kɔ baabi
move.body: Sɛ wode sika kɔ Mobile Money so a, akorae abien no na ɛsesa; wo adetɔn nsesa.

reverse.title: Siesie mfomso
reverse.body: Wura anaa ɔhwɛfo tumi twa biribi mu. Nea edi kan no tena hɔ, wɔhyɛ no nsow sɛ wɔatwa mu, na sika no san ba.

paper.title: Invoice ne risiti
paper.body: Invoice yɛ ka krataa ma odetɔni. Risiti kyerɛ sika a woanya. Twe biara sɛ PDF. Emu biara mfa adetɔn foforo nka ho.

documents.title: Invoice anaa risiti
documents.invoiceIntro: Eyi kyerɛw adetɔn no na ɛyɛ ka krataa a wubetumi atwe sɛ PDF. Ɛnyɛ adetɔn foforo.
documents.receiptIntro: Risiti kyerɛ sika a woanya. "Watua seesei" kyerɛw adetɔn no sɛ watua ne nyinaa. Anaa paw bi a ɛwɔ nwoma no mu dedaw.
documents.savedOffline: Wɔakora wɔ fon yi so. PDF no bɛyɛ krado bere a intanɛt bɛba na akɔ.
documents.noneToReceipt: Adetɔn anaa akatua biara nni ha ɛ.

errors.generic: Biribi ankɔ yiye. Yɛsrɛ wo san sɔ hwɛ.
errors.network: Intanɛt nni hɔ. Hwɛ wo intanɛt na san sɔ hwɛ.
errors.AZ_INVALID_INPUT: Nsɛm no bi nteɛ. Yɛsrɛ wo hwɛ na san sɔ hwɛ.
errors.AZ_CONTACT_REQUIRED: Paw odetɔni ma adetɔn a wontuaa ɛ.
errors.AZ_EXCEEDS_DEBT: Akatua no boro ka a odetɔni no de.
errors.AZ_NO_MONEY_RECEIVED: Sika biara amma eyi ho, enti risiti nni hɔ.
errors.AZ_SUPPORT_NOT_GRANTED: Wura no mmaa mmoafo kwan wɔ sotɔɔ yi ho, anaa bere no atwam.

add.saleHint: Sika a ɛwɔ nsam, Mobile Money anaa ka
add.expenseHint: Adwuma no ka, anaa nneɛma a wotɔe sɛ wobɛtɔn
add.transferHint: Sika a ɛwɔ nsam, Mobile Money ne sikakorabea ntam
add.ownerHint: Wo ankasa sika a ɛba adwuma no mu anaa efi mu
add.invoiceHint: Ka krataa ma odetɔni, sɛ PDF
add.receiptHint: Adanse sɛ woanya sika, sɛ PDF

owner.title: Wura no sika
owner.in: Mede me ankasa sika baa adwuma no mu
owner.hint: Wura no sika nyɛ adetɔn, na ɛnyɛ ɛka.

support.intro: Hwehwɛ sotɔɔ a wobɛboa. Wubetumi abue sotɔɔ bere a ne wura ama kwan nko ara, na wubetumi ahwɛ nko ara; wontumi nsesa hwee. Nea woyɛ wɔ ha nyinaa wɔkyerɛw.
support.search: Sotɔɔ din anaa wura no email
support.noAccess: Mmoafo nni kwan. Ka kyerɛ wura no sɛ ɔmma kwan wɔ Nhyehyɛe, Kokoamsɛm ne nsɛm a wɔakora mu.
support.reason: Nea enti (wobetumi aka akyerɛ wura no)
support.reasonNeeded: Kyerɛw nea enti; nkyerɛwde abiɛsa anaa nea ɛboro saa.
support.ownerIntro: Sɛ biribi ankɔ yiye a, wubetumi ama Azaria mmoafo ahwɛ sotɔɔ yi bere tiaa bi. Wobetumi akenkan wo nsɛm de aboa wo. Wontumi mfa hwee nka ho, nsesa hwee, na mpopa hwee, na wubetumi agyae bere biara.
support.ownerOnly: Wura no nko ara na otumi ma mmoafo kwan anaa ogyae.
support.activeUntil: Mmoafo betumi ahwɛ sotɔɔ yi kosi {time}.

guide.title: Akwankyerɛ
guide.userHint: Nea wubetumi ayɛ wɔ Azaria mu nyinaa, anammɔn anammɔn
guide.adminHint: Ma wuranom ne ahwɛfo: nnipa, nsiesie, nsɛm a wɔakora ne mmoafo kwan
guide.loadError: Akwankyerɛ no antumi ammue. Hwɛ wo intanɛt na san sɔ hwɛ.
guide.englishOnly: Akwankyerɛ yi wɔ Borɔfo kasa mu seesei.
guide.noMatch: Biribiara nni ha a ɛne nea worehwehwɛ no hyia.

about.title: Azaria ho nsɛm
about.hint: App no abakɔsɛm ne nea egyina ma
